name: Sumoto (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sumoto city emblem in white: three overlapping discs arranged in a triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Sumoto, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 February 2006.

features.role: Sumoto city emblem — three overlapping discs arranged in a triangle
